subject: Renewal kickoff: NPI capacity increase & term update (BeaconTech)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@beacontech.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal kickoff: NPI capacity increase & term update (BeaconTech)

Hi Ellen —

Congrats again on the successful NPI pilots last quarter. Per our renewal conversation, BeaconTech’s usage profile shows a predictable step-up once the new product line goes GA. I wanted to kick off a short renewal/expansion timeline so we can align on:

- target contract term and start date (current contract expires 2027-06-30)
- requested capacity increase for NPI (anticipated 2.5–3x peak token throughput)
- pricing/term options (commit tiers vs on-demand burst)
- QBR / technical handoff and go-live readiness review

Proposed high-level timeline (we can adjust):
- Apr 18: kickoff + stakeholder list (you)
- Apr 19–25: usage & capacity analysis (redwood & BeaconTech)
- Apr 26–May 6: internal approvals & procurement window
- May 9–13: QBR + contract review
- Effective date: 2027-07-01 (aligned to start of next billing period)

Would you be available for a 60-minute QBR on one of these windows: May 3–6? If you prefer a specific day/time, send it and we’ll lock it. I attached a draft SOW that outlines the proposed capacity uplift and optional burst pools for the NPI ramp.

Next steps from our side: Marcus will pull month-by-month token usage and spike patterns; Priyom will prepare proposed term/discount scenarios; Sofia (cc) will consolidate QBR agenda with Monica from CS.

Attachments: SOW_proposed_terms_2027-04-18.pdf

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Ellen Park <ellen@beacontech.com>

Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@beacontech.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: NPI capacity increase & term update (BeaconTech)

Marcus — thanks for the clear plan. High level OK from my side; a few notes from procurement/finance and scheduling constraints:

- Procurement needs a 30-day lead time for contract review and signatures (procurement holidays in late May will compress our window)
- We expect the NPI ramp to start mid-July but the engineering go-live may push some peak traffic into August — would prefer start date 2027-07-15 if that makes sense on your end
- For the QBR, May 4 or May 6 AM PT work best for me. I can loop in Tom from infra so he can speak to peak throughput and expected burst windows.

I’ve attached our procurement checklist for reference. If you can provide the finalized SOW + pricing scenarios by Apr 25, procurement will be able to run approvals in time.

Attaching: BeaconTech_procurement_checklist.pdf

—Ellen
Ellen Park
VP Product Operations | BeaconTech
ellen@beacontech.com | +1 212-555-0199

Folks — forwarding Ellen’s reply. Quick alignment notes and owners: 

- Priyom: please prepare 2 pricing scenarios by Apr 24 — (A) 12-month commitment with a 20% uplift discount and burst pool; (B) 6-month flexible term with graduated burst credits. Include estimated monthly cost delta for 2.5x and 3x peak.
- Marcus: please include month-by-month usage with daily peak percentiles (p90/p99) by Apr 22 so we can size dedicated vs burst allocation.
- Monica (CS): draft QBR agenda and readiness checklist (include runbook handoff, KV cache priming plan, expected latency SLOs under load). Can you have a first cut by Apr 23?

I’ll coordinate scheduling with Ellen; she prefers May 4 or May 6 AM PT. I’ll propose May 4 10:00 AM PT as a primary and May 6 10:00 AM PT as backup.

When you reply, please paste the spreadsheet or a short bulleted sizing answer — procurement is tight and Ellen asks final SOW + pricing by Apr 25.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
